title: Title Case In Place
hints: You need to know, for each character, whether it starts a word. A word starts at the beginning of the string or right after a whitespace character.
Keep a `bool at_word_start = true;`. For each character: if it's whitespace, set the flag to true; otherwise upper- or lowercase it depending on the flag, then set the flag to false.
`if (isspace(c)) { at_start = true; } else { s[i] = (char)(at_start ? toupper(c) : tolower(c)); at_start = false; }` with `c = (unsigned char)s[i]`.
